### Observed differences

In the later window, the outgoing transitions of activity A37 shifted slightly: the share going to A38 increased from about 45.5% to 54.4%, while the share going to A39 decreased from about 54.5% to 45.6%. The overall difference is small (cosine dissimilarity 0.015) and is based on roughly 333–336 observed transitions in each window. [DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a change in the process. Only one control-flow item was flagged, while about 0.27 such items are expected by chance alone; a single item of this size is consistent with random variation, despite its high empirical strength. [DIR001, screening.by_family.control_flow]
